# The byte gate's cases (design SIM-4, internal/bytegate). One per line: a name, a colon, and
# the arguments of one blis invocation. The gate adds --scenarios testdata/bytegate/scenarios,
# --catalog and --registry (the selected substrate's), and compares standard output with
# golden/<name>.json. Each case states its seed, so no default seed is part of the record.
#
# The scenarios are fixed copies: a scenario elsewhere in the repository may change for its own
# reasons, and the gate must not move with it. They cover a colocated MoE deployment, that
# deployment with data parallelism above one (the aggregate-vs-per-rank case), one instance and
# a cluster through the router, a speculative deployment with expert parallelism, and a
# disaggregated (P/D) deployment, under the open-loop and the closed-loop clients.
moe-single: run --scenario gpt-oss-120b-h100-fp4-vllm-tp2.yaml --rate 8 --num-requests 40 --seed 3
moe-dp2: run --scenario minimax-m2.5-b200-fp4-vllm-tp2-ep4-dp2.yaml --rate 4 --num-requests 30 --seed 2
moe-cluster: run --scenario gpt-oss-120b-h100-fp4-vllm-tp2.yaml --num-instances 4 --rate 30 --num-requests 120 --seed 5
moe-closed-loop: run --scenario gpt-oss-120b-h100-fp4-vllm-tp2.yaml --num-instances 2 --concurrency 16 --num-requests 64 --seed 11
# moe-prefix scrapes the endpoints' metrics out of phase (--epp-scrape-jitter): its arrivals are 50 ms apart, the router's default
# scrape period is 50 ms, and with every endpoint scraped in phase at t=0 each decision reads metrics a full period stale at the
# same phase, so a 0.5% step-time shift moves a completion across a scrape boundary and flips the whole routing (inference-sim#2157).
# Its seed was chosen by a scan (inference-sim#2219). The router's choice on a shared prefix is an argmax of weighted scores over
# scraped state, so for most seeds the split is a knife edge or a pile-up: seed 13 sends all 80 requests to one instance. Seed 21
# splits 42/38 and stays within 5 requests of that, with a mean TPOT within 5%, under step-time shifts of up to 1.5% either way.
# TestByteGateRoutingCaseSurvivesAStepTimeShift holds the case to this.
moe-prefix: run --scenario gpt-oss-120b-h100-fp4-vllm-tp2.yaml --num-instances 2 --rate 20 --num-requests 80 --prefix-tokens 2048 --seed 21 --epp-scrape-jitter 50000
spec-ep: run --scenario muse-h200-ib-tep8-dspark.yaml --rate 4 --num-requests 30 --seed 2
pd: run --scenario glm-5-h200-3p1d-ib.yaml --num-instances 4 --prefill-instances 3 --decode-instances 1 --rate 4 --num-requests 30 --seed 2
